Question: Let \(f(x)=4x-x^2.\) Given \(x_0,\) consider the sequence defined by \(x_n=f(x_{n-1})\) for all \(n\ge1.\) For how many real numbers \(x_0\) will the sequence \(x_0,\) \(x_1,\) \(x_2,\) \(\ldots\) take on only a finite number of different values?
